units.source_text: 可是，阔别了三个月，春上他从镇上的寿司铺寄来一封信。

en.t: But after three months without word, in the spring he sent a letter from a sushi shop in town.

units.source_text: 是写给十六岁的少女阿雪的，他一五一十地告诉了阿雪，他从这儿的女人那里染上了病。

en.t: It was addressed to A-yuki, a sixteen-year-old girl, and he told her everything plainly: he had caught the disease from a woman here.
